answer: Require each identity to escrow a 740-unit bond and serve a thirty-five epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for fifteen rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 740 units per alias and replays thirty-five rounds, while a pearl of matched traces exposes the ring, terrace routing scatters assignments, and shale records make altered evidence detectable.
